item_short_desc: The SABRE Pepper Gel with Finger Grip and Key Ring can help you protect yourself from those that may not have your best interest in mind by providing maximum strength protection that’s easily carried on the go.
description: The SABRE Pepper Gel with Finger Grip and Key Ring can help you protect yourself from those that may not have your best interest in mind by providing maximum strength protection that’s easily carried on the go. This pepper gel contains 25 bursts (5x the competition) for protection against multiple threats. Pepper gel is safer with a long, 12-foot (4 meter) range to help protect you from a safe distance. Pepper gel is safe to use indoors as it does not atomize like traditional pepper sprays and is deployed in a powerful gel stream, virtually eliminating wind blowback. UV marking dye helps the authorities identify an attacker after they’re sprayed. An ergonomic finger grip helps to improve your aim and gives you more control while using your pepper gel. A flip tpp safety prevents an accidental discharge in your purse or bag. Key ring easily attaches onto keys or lanyards for quick access to your protection if needed.
